events.title: US election
events.note: Stocks jumped the day after the US election; high-beta tech led.

events.title: Hawkish Fed cut
events.note: The Fed cut but signalled fewer 2025 cuts; the S&P 500 fell ~3% in a day.

events.title: DeepSeek shock
events.note: A cheap Chinese AI model hit AI-chip stocks; NVIDIA lost ~17% in a day.

events.title: Growth scare
events.note: Recession and tariff worries drove a sharp Nasdaq sell-off.

events.title: Liberation Day tariffs
events.note: Sweeping US tariffs set off the biggest two-day drop since 2020; VIX spiked above 50.

events.title: Tariff pause
events.note: A 90-day pause on most tariffs sparked one of the best days in decades.

events.title: US-China truce
events.note: US and China cut tariffs for 90 days; chip stocks rallied hard.
